notes.title: Join our next Playtest on Saturday, May 1!
notes.content:
[h1]Sup, raw men (and women too)![/h1]

Our team wants to say a big, big "Thank you" to all of you people who participated in the previous playtest last weekend. Five hundred freaking animals putting on an absolute soup-slingin' clinic? You guys are just beyond awesome. By the way, we also appreciate you taking your time to give us some valuable feedback. When you're too lazy to do your job as an indie dev, it's always nice to have someone do it for you.

So, with that said, we'd like to take you all out for another playtest. The date and the time remain the same: [b]Saturday, May 1, 11am PT / 2pm ET / 8pm CET.[/b]

[h3]Here's how to get started:[/h3]

[h3][b]1. SIGN UP [/b]for the playtest on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/782940/RAWMEN_Food_Fighter_Arena/]RAWMEN Steam page[/url][/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/g0SCJZI.gif[/img]

[h3][b]2. JOIN [/b] the official [url=https://discord.com/invite/rawmen]RAWMEN Discord[/url] for playtest news and game updates.[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Note:[/b] If you don't receive a key via Steam but you are still craving to join the playtest and get your candy ass kicked—or if you'd like to bring some [strike]victims[/strike] friends along for the fun—head to the [b]Key Requests[/b] channel in the [url=https://discord.gg/rawmen]Official RAWMEN Discord[/url] and we'll getcha set up. If you ask nicely.
[/list]
[h3][b]3. STAY TUNED [/b]for a notification that you've been invited. [/h3]

[h3][b]4. PLAY[/b] some RAWMEN, obviously. And don't forget to give us feedback on what sucks and what doesn't. [/h3]
[list]
[*] Once you're invited, you can launch the Playtest client from Steam at any time to customize your soup-slinger and experiment in the Practice mode. 
[*] Multiplayer servers will come online at 11AM PDT on May 1.
[/list]
Each week we increase the total number of invites sent and make sure to adjust the timing of each playtest to ensure that everyone has a chance to participate. Even people in Antarctica. 

[h3]Can't wait until the playtest? Itch that scratch with the souper special playtest preview:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=HROX4629Euw;full][/previewyoutube]


Be sure to follow us on the ol’ socials for delicious news and updates:
[list]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/rawmengame]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/rawmengame/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/rawmen]Discord [/url]
[/list]

[i]Yours truly,[/i]

ANIMAL & tinyBuild

notes.title: Play the updated alpha and new game mode on the Autumn Steam Game Festival
notes.content:
[h2]What's up, chowder heads!?[/h2]

First of all - thank you to those who had tried our alpha out while we test new features, and tweak current ones!

Thats right! We’re back with an updated build for the Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition!

We have been hard at work with lots of behind the scenes work, quality of life improvements, and general dopeness. (at least to us) It’s hard to sometimes think of this as an alpha!

We encourage you to gather some friends and play together!

[b]Since you last played - heres what we just added! [/b]

[list]
[*] We’ve started to integrate the new character centric UI which should be pretty apparent upon loading up the game.
[*] New prototype game mode we’re trying out: Bombs Away! Race to the top and hold the claim!
[*] Female meat chassis added
[*] We’ve added some content to the customizer to create more salty beauty 
[*] The Unique cross channel Twitch integration! Multiple streamers can be in one game and all their chats can participate, voting for fun modifiers!
[*] We’ve put down the framework for progression, however - its not currently in use. So unlocking and character leveling etc is soon to come.
[*] Lots of gameplay tweaks and bug fixes (we hope!) 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34437195/c34ee3a3feb8d273fd338ecba5a2e3573201aa42.jpg[/img]
Bombs Away Game Mode! - Climb to the top, and fight for your claim as superior soup savior!

[h3]Oh and finally! Listen up pip squeaks![/h3]
WE NEED YOUR FEEDBACK! Grab this alpha now on Steam! Fill out the in-game survey before Oct 14th with a real email, and you’ll recieve the OFFICAL limited  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/207140/SpeedRunners/]SpeedRunners[/url][/i][/b] item!:Hot Head RAWMEN mitt once it's ready to go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34437195/9f0d46392a84992e8ffb8a0fcfc50e2635ecfb7d.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/782940/RAWMEN/

[url=https://twitter.com/rawmengame]https://twitter.com/rawmengame[/url]

[/url]

notes.title: PAX Alpha Demo - Available now during PAX Online!
notes.content:
Grab the free alpha of RAWMEN during the duration of the PAX online event!

We've listened to your feedback, and watched a lot of y'all play - There's still a long way to go, but we'd love for you to grab some friends and hop into our soup tossin', broth sippin', meatball rollin' alpha, and get messy! Our small team has put LOTS of love into this, and is excited to share the alpha with you! That being said, we've included a small survey at the end, and would really appreciate any feedback on how to make the experience better as we chip away!

We've made a lot of changes and improvements as we iterate through development. A few highlights in this build: Early Twitch integration, various weapon tweaks, a new test map, a new Meat Chassis added to the customizer, along with some other new dank looks to choose from!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34437195/ece69b06d5b9f861edafea069b5a3db4534e9b45.jpg[/img]

While its in a very early stage, we've included the Bouillon Coliseum - a small tight map with an emphasis on sliding, getting air, and tracking targets!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34437195/d630dc5feb9f39efae7bfb063baf260d5acb3d3e.jpg[/img]

As per usual, this is still an early (WIP) work in progress, so things might go wrong - but we're looking forward to hearing your thoughts and watching you play!

- ANIMAL

notes.title: New RAWMEN gameplay trailer is here!
notes.content:
Greetings friends!

We announced RAWMEN back in August and since then the game had tons of juicy new features, revamped visuals, and most importantly - new game modes. 

Take a look at the trailer:

[previewyoutube=wd2Y_oM7jFE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Introducing the Meatball game mode[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34437195/5819dd0b40c809548dbbbd5e9b10bf87ca96eb70.gif[/img]

You know what makes a game about ramen better? Meatballs. The new game mode focuses on a giant meatball, and your team's goal is to throw that meat into the enemy goal. So think Katamari meets Rocket League. Any player can attach oneself to the meatball, and control it around the map.

[h3]Introducing wall biscuits[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34437195/90b78c99c9756515e9486063f129f9ae7f07b7f9.gif[/img]

We're spicing up the gameplay with deployable walls, which are great for defending your goal. These break up the chaos of RAWMEN and make it much more tactical. Right now any player has deployable walls on a cooldown. 

[h3]Introducing the duck turret[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34437195/111bfae139c934b9cc58fec2c6b6f188e7de3812.gif[/img]

In hindsight, maybe it should've been a goose turret. The deployable turret shoots all enemies in its line of sight. You can use your handy pot to block off attacks though. Currently, the duck turret is a rare randomized pickup item. 

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/rawmengame]Twitter [/url] for more meaty updates!
